teams.subtitle: From here you can

actions.name: Give it a name.
actions.privacy: Choose whether it is public or private.
actions.rentalCode: Add a Rental Code when applicable.
actions.edit: Edit its information whenever you need to.
actions.delete: Delete teams you no longer use.

teams.infoText: Each team stores the information you need to later use it in Team Sheets or share it with other players.

pokemon.title: Pokémon Management
pokemon.lead: For each Pokémon, you can register all the information used to prepare your competitive team.
pokemon.callout: All this information stays organized so you can review, edit, and reuse your Pokémon whenever you need to.

teamSheets.title: Creating Team Sheets
teamSheets.lead: Pokecircuit offers different ways to generate Team Sheets that are ready to use and print for your tournaments.

registered.title: From a registered team
registered.description: If you already have a team saved in Pokecircuit, the Team Sheet can be generated automatically using the information you have stored.

manual.title: Manual entry
manual.description: Enter each Pokémon's information manually. This is a quick option when you have not registered the team on the platform yet.

images.title: From Pokémon Champions images
images.description: Upload screenshots from the game and Pokecircuit will process the information to help generate the Team Sheet.

print.title: Your Team Sheet ready for the tournament
print.description: Once generated, you can print it and use it during your competitions.

tournaments.title: Tournaments
tournaments.lead: Browse registered tournaments and review the information you need to follow each event.
tournaments.note: This makes it easy to review past events, check player performance, and see how each tournament unfolded.

publicTeams.lead: Teams configured as public can be viewed by the community.
